title: Connecting a sales channel or books app
summary: Bring in orders and products from your store, or send invoices to your accounting software.

steps.text: Open {access} from Settings. Celerp Connect adds {website} to bring in orders, products and customers from Shopify and WooCommerce on a schedule.
The same subscription adds {accounting} to push invoices and contacts to QuickBooks or Xero and reconcile the bank feed, so nothing is entered twice.
Once Celerp Connect is active, this page gains a Website tab and an Accounting tab; open either one to connect a store or books app and choose how often it syncs.
